title: The Tent

scene_beats.setting: Day 1. Every Page dark but never total. A small tent outside Eldoria, one candle inside.
scene_beats.action: The Stilling hits Mote: 6 fps, Bond dimmed, bubbles gray scribbles.

scene_beats.setting: Inside the tent. Sethra sits on a blanket, knees up, Thorne's tablets beside her.
scene_beats.action: Sit with her. Nothing else is required. Stay as long as you want.

scene_beats.setting: Same tent, much later. Candle burned low. A tiny scarf wrapped around Mote's neck.
scene_beats.action: Sethra ties a tiny scarf on Mote before Arin goes.

dialogue.speaker: Sethra
text_lines: He made this. For a cat he

zeref_moment: Zeref sits so long the candle burns out. He stays.

title: Up to Her Neck

scene_beats.setting: Day 2. The cold Tigra. Sethra stands up to her neck in the river, silent, mourning.
scene_beats.action: Arin finds her at the shore, flint and wick in hand for a fire.

scene_beats.setting: A dazzling kind figure on the water. Perfect white light, no flicker. Its feet make no shadow.
scene_beats.action: The Counterfeit Angel calls. Choice: point at its feet, or let her go.

scene_beats.setting: Shore at dusk. Sethra wrapped in a blanket by a small fire, skin cold as grass. Mote glows faint.
scene_beats.action: She comes out (if she went, Dusk Walk its feet into twilight to save her). Warm her with Mote's Glow.

dialogue.speaker: Sethra
text_lines: It was so kind. It was

zeref_moment: Zeref swims out to Sethra. Very angry about it. Brave.

title: Hidden Doorway

scene_beats.setting: Day 3. Dark forest. The Bramble Warden, green and gentle now, plants seeds as it walks.
scene_beats.action: The Warden leads them to a door between two entwined ancient trees.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble Warden
text_lines: I found my way. Now I show

scene_beats.setting: Doorway of twisted bark, lavender light leaking from the cracks. Music, faintly.
scene_beats.action: Arin pushes the door open.

scene_beats.setting: Realm of Dreams: rolling hills under swirling galaxies, chiming fairy lights. A different night.
scene_beats.action: They step in. Laughter and music. The dark here feels warm.

dungeon.name: The Hidden Doorway

rooms.description: Path to the doorway; the dark forest under Stilling.
rooms.puzzle: Counterfeit Lights offer rest; walk past, never stop on their glow.

rooms.description: Entwined trees, bark door with root locks.
rooms.puzzle: The Warden opens one root per seed you help it plant.

rooms.description: Lavender slope inside, dream drift inverts controls slowly.
rooms.puzzle: Follow fairy chimes; drift flips left and right.

dungeon.no_boss_note: Bible 5.3 has no fight here: the Warden leads you through the doorway. No boss (none invented).

zeref_moment: Zeref's eyes match the swirling galaxies exactly.

title: The Festival

scene_beats.setting: Day 4. A huge tree hung with lanterns, a grand stage, tiny glowing fairies everywhere.
scene_beats.action: The Fairy Host invites them to the festival. The Dreamweaver plays a lyre.

scene_beats.setting: Dance floor of moss under lanterns. Rhythm prompts float up like fireflies. No fail state.
scene_beats.action: Rhythm mini-game. You cannot fail.

scene_beats.setting: Storytelling circle by the stage. A young woman, then Arin, then Sethra. Flipbook pages float.
scene_beats.action: Sharing of Tales: Arin's Tale from the Memory Ledger. Sethra tells Thorne's.

zeref_moment: Zeref dances off-beat all night. Declared best dancer.

title: Gift of Dreams
location: Realm of Dreams Festival at Night

scene_beats.setting: Day 5. Festival stage at dawn. The fairies hand the Dreamweaver a carved wooden flute.
scene_beats.action: The Dreamweaver plays the flute once, softly.

scene_beats.setting: Glowing orbs float down from the galaxy sky into every open hand, including Mote's paw.
scene_beats.action: Dream Orbs, pieces of True Light.

dialogue.speaker: Dreamweaver
text_lines: May it inspire you on your

scene_beats.setting: Orbs released: they burst like shooting stars, landing on every Page as new Surviving Lights.
scene_beats.action: Mote's Stilling breaks. It shakes itself like a wet dog. Color returns.

zeref_moment: Zeref gets shaken dry by Mote. He is not wet. Still mad.

title: Road to the Edge
location: Empty Highway to the Erased Margins

scene_beats.setting: Day 6. Empty Highway: two-lane road, night blue, sodium orange lights that never get closer.
scene_beats.action: The Tattered Traveler hands over the Rattlecart keys.

dialogue.speaker: Tattered Traveler
text_lines: I am the road. Kind of.

scene_beats.setting: Inside the Rattlecart. Mote in the passenger seat, Zeref on the dash, headlights on the dark road.
scene_beats.action: Longest drive in the game. Mote points at places from your Memory Ledger.

scene_beats.setting: Road ends at the Erased Margins: half-drawn terrain, pencil lines, eraser crumbs as boulders.
scene_beats.action: A lighthouse stands where the road stops. Its light is warm and flickers.

zeref_moment: Zeref rides shotgun with his head out the window.

title: Malakar Unflowing
location: Malakar's Map Room and the Stilled Sea

scene_beats.setting: Malakar's Map Room: tower on a Stilled Sea frozen mid-wave. Thousands of maps, floor to ceiling.
scene_beats.action: Optional: collect 12 Corner Sketches. Early maps show a cart, two seats, one filled.

scene_beats.setting: Night. Stilled Sea arena. Malakar, calm, folds the whole beach like a map.
scene_beats.action: The final boss: Malakar, the Unflowing. Four phases.

scene_beats.setting: Shoreline after. An old two-seat cart, Malakar in one seat. The passenger seat is empty.
scene_beats.action: Phase 4, not a fight: Attune (breathe, Point), Strike, or Rest (only if Sethra went).

rooms.description: Map Room stairs, maps drift down like snow.
rooms.puzzle: Collect Corner Sketches: Point at each map with a cart.

rooms.description: Hall of later maps, all corners blank.
rooms.puzzle: Dusk Walk the hall; counterfeits gain shadows and can be hit.
Ground is unfinished: Draw Mode a path before you step.

rooms.description: The Stilled Sea beach at night.

boss.name: Malakar, the Unflowing
boss.mechanic: P1 fold the arena, Draw Mode bridges. P2 perfect light, Dusk Walk to the seam and strike his shadow. P3 Arin freezes, control Mote alone. P4 Attune, Strike or Rest.

idle_animation.description: Stands calm by the frozen sea, maps rustling under his arm, cloak never moving.

phases.transformation: The Cartographer: a tall calm man; the whole beach creases and folds like his map.

attacks.name: Fold
attacks.telegraph: The ground creases with a line

attacks.name: Paper Wall
attacks.effect: Walls slide in from the sides

phases.transformation: The Counterfeit: he becomes perfect white light, sky-high, beautiful, shadowless, untouchable.

attacks.name: Offer of Rest
attacks.effect: Fills Stilling; Dusk Walk to the seam

attacks.name: Perfect Light
attacks.effect: White beam freezes what it hits

phases.transformation: The Unflowing: a gigantic tide of stillness. Arin freezes into a drawing; the Mote crosses alone.

attacks.name: Stilled Wave
attacks.telegraph: A frozen wave rises over the horizon
attacks.effect: Wave crushes a lane; Mote dodges

animation.description: Rise, tower, tip, fall, freeze, crack

attacks.name: Total Still
attacks.telegraph: The sea goes silent, all color drains
attacks.effect: Mote slows; use Echoes, keep moving

phases.transformation: The Empty Seat: not a fight. Malakar sits small in an old two-seat cart; the seat is empty.

attacks.name: The Slowest Breath
attacks.telegraph: His chest rises once, very slow

animation.description: In, hold, out, in, hold, out

defeat_animation.description: Attune: tears fall, one wave moves, then another, sea flows, he walks off, lets a crab pass.

boss.canon: bible boss #13 (The Stilled Sea, Act V, 4 phases per bible Section 9; Attunable in Phase 4; final boss)
boss.sprite_note: P3: Mote's Spark fires at Ink stage (scripted if not); Arin stands with 1 Heart; a butterfly lands on Malakar. P4 Attune -> end_a/end_d, Strike -> end_b, Rest -> end_c.

zeref_moment: Zeref hops into the empty seat. Then gets out. Not his.

title: Rest / 8th Page

scene_beats.setting: Day 7. Rest. The world quiet, not frozen. Rivers move slowly. Grumbleback, Rime, the Warden.
scene_beats.action: A playable day where nothing is required. Visit anyone.

scene_beats.setting: Day 8, Brindlemark forge at night, one light. The horizon is slightly brighter. Mote asleep in the cart.
scene_beats.action: The ending plays (A canon). Master Hollis by the forge. The bear falls on Malakar.

scene_beats.setting: A blank sheet of paper fills the screen. One prompt: Draw the next page.
scene_beats.action: The Eighth Page: draw anything. It becomes your Folio cover.

zeref_moment: Zeref draws the first line on the 8th Page. It is a paw.
